new_entities.name: FXTrade
new_entities.description: Aggregate root for a foreign exchange spot trade executed by the Treasury Services capability (SVC-007) on behalf of a corporate client. Created in PH-059 with status=enquiry and progresses through the full FX trade lifecycle. Owns the complete audit trail from indicative rate request through to settlement. Owned exclusively by SVC-007 (Treasury Services, CAP-002.04 promoted). Referenced by ENT-041 (FXQuote) and ENT-042 (FXSettlement) via trade_id FK.

fields.name: trade_id
fields.validation_rule: RFC 4122 UUID v4. System-generated. Immutable. Globally unique across the bank's treasury trading book.

fields.name: client_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. FK → BusinessCustomer.business_customer_id (ENT-079, owned by SVC-005). Immutable. SVC-007 holds no local copy of BusinessCustomer data — this is a reference only.

fields.name: dealer_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. FK → Staff.staff_id for PER-053 (Treasury Dealer). Immutable. Must be a currently FCA-certified dealer under SM&CR.

fields.name: buy_currency
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 4217 3-letter currency code. e.g. USD, EUR, GBP. Immutable after status = booked.

fields.name: buy_amount
fields.validation_rule: Required after PH-061. Positive decimal, max 2 dp. Amount the client will receive in buy_currency. Computed from sell_amount × rate (or sell_amount / rate depending on quoting convention). Immutable after status = booked.

fields.name: sell_currency
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 4217 3-letter currency code. The currency the client is selling. Must differ from buy_currency. Immutable after status = booked.

fields.name: sell_amount
fields.validation_rule: Required. Positive decimal, max 2 dp. Amount the client will deliver in sell_currency. Immutable after status = booked.

fields.name: rate
fields.validation_rule: Required after PH-061. Positive decimal, 6 decimal places. All-in FX rate inclusive of spread at which the trade was transacted. Populated from FXQuote.firm_rate on acceptance. Immutable after status = booked.

fields.name: value_date
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). Spot = T+2 business days from dealt_at. Cannot be a weekend or UK/counterparty bank holiday. Immutable after status = booked.

fields.name: status
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: enquiry | booked | confirmed | settlement_held | settlement_failed | settled | cancelled. Transitions: enquiry → booked (quote accepted); booked → confirmed (MT300 sent); confirmed → settled (settlement complete) or settlement_held (sanctions hit) or settlement_failed (balance insufficient).

fields.name: dealt_at
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. ISO 8601 UTC. Set when status transitions to booked (FXQuote accepted). Immutable. MiFIR reporting timestamp.

fields.name: confirmation_sent
fields.validation_rule: Required. Default false. Set to true when SWIFT MT300 dispatched (PH-062). MiFIR and COBS 16.3 compliance flag.

fields.name: call_recording_ref
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Populated for voice-executed trades only (ALT-001). Reference to the call recording stored in the bank's COBS 11.2A call recording system. Format: CALL-{YYYY}-{NNNNNN}.

fields.name: mifir_transaction_ref
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Set after MiFIR report submitted to FCA trade repository. Format: UTI (Unique Transaction Identifier) per ESMA UTI technical standards. Populated in PH-062.
fields.computed_from: Generated by SVC-007 on trade execution using ISO 23897 UTI standard

fields.name: interbank_reference_rate
fields.validation_rule: Required. Positive decimal, 6 decimal places. The Bloomberg FXGO mid-rate at time of quote used as the best-execution reference benchmark. Captured for MiFIR best execution evidence. Immutable.

fields.name: created_at
fields.validation_rule: System-generated. ISO 8601 UTC. Immutable.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.validation_rule: System-generated. ISO 8601 UTC. Updated on any field mutation.

relationships.description: FXTrade may have multiple FXQuote records (re-quotes on expiry), but only one with status = accepted.
FXTrade has one FXSettlement record created at PH-063.
FXTrade belongs to one BusinessCustomer via client_id FK. BusinessCustomer is owned by SVC-005 — SVC-007 holds no local copy.

design_decisions.decision: FXTrade stores interbank_reference_rate as an immutable field alongside the executed rate.
design_decisions.rationale: UK MiFIR best execution obligations require the bank to demonstrate that the client received a rate no worse than the interbank reference rate minus the approved mark-up. Storing the Bloomberg mid-rate at quote time provides an auditable best-execution evidence trail co-located with the trade record.

design_decisions.decision: FXTrade.rate is denormalised from FXQuote.firm_rate on acceptance.
design_decisions.rationale: The accepted rate is the most frequently queried field (confirmation documents, MiFIR reports, settlement instructions). Denormalisation avoids a join to ENT-041 on every read. FXQuote remains the canonical source of truth for the quote lifecycle; FXTrade.rate is a derived, immutable copy.

new_entities.name: FXQuote
new_entities.description: An FX spot rate quotation generated by SVC-007 (Treasury Services) for a specific FX trade enquiry. Linked to ENT-040 (FXTrade) via trade_id FK. Tracks the full lifecycle from indicative to firm quote and through to acceptance, expiry, or rejection. Multiple FXQuote records may exist per FXTrade (re-quote on expiry). Created in PH-060. Owned by SVC-007.

fields.name: quote_id
fields.validation_rule: RFC 4122 UUID v4. System-generated. Immutable.

fields.name: trade_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. FK → FXTrade.trade_id (ENT-040). Immutable. Many FXQuotes may reference one FXTrade.

fields.name: indicative_rate
fields.validation_rule: Required. Positive decimal, 6 decimal places. The non-binding indicative rate shown to the client in PH-059. Sourced from Bloomberg FXGO at enquiry time.
fields.derived_from: Bloomberg FXGO mid-rate + approved indicative mark-up at time of PH-059 enquiry

fields.name: firm_rate
fields.validation_rule: Required. Positive decimal, 6 decimal places. The legally binding all-in rate at which SVC-007 will transact if the client accepts within valid_until. Includes the bank's approved spread. Immutable after status = quoted.
fields.derived_from: Bloomberg FXGO mid-rate at firm-quote time + approved full mark-up for client tier

fields.name: spread
fields.validation_rule: Required. Positive decimal, 6 decimal places. The bank's FX margin expressed as half-spread either side of the mid-rate. Captured for MiFIR best execution disclosure and internal P&L attribution.
fields.derived_from: firm_rate minus Bloomberg FXGO mid-rate at firm-quote time

fields.name: valid_until
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 8601 UTC. Calculated as quoted_at + 30 seconds. FXQuote is void after this timestamp. SVC-007 enforces server-side validation on acceptance.

fields.name: status
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: quoted | accepted | expired | rejected. Transitions: quoted → accepted (client confirms within valid_until); quoted → expired (valid_until exceeded before acceptance); quoted → rejected (client explicitly declines).

fields.name: quoted_at
fields.validation_rule: System-generated. ISO 8601 UTC. Timestamp when firm quote was issued. Immutable. Used to verify valid_until and for MiFIR reporting.

fields.name: accepted_at
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. ISO 8601 UTC. Populated when status = accepted. Must be < valid_until. Immutable.

relationships.description: FXQuote belongs to one FXTrade via trade_id FK.

design_decisions.decision: spread is stored as a computed field derived from firm_rate minus mid-rate, not entered directly by the dealer.
design_decisions.rationale: Capturing spread as a derived value from observable inputs (firm_rate and Bloomberg mid-rate) provides an independent audit trail for MiFIR best execution disclosure. If spread were entered directly, there would be no cross-check against the interbank reference. The computed_from provenance chain is preserved for regulatory review.

design_decisions.decision: valid_until is enforced server-side by SVC-007, not solely by the portal UI.
design_decisions.rationale: A client could bypass the UI countdown by submitting an acceptance request directly to the API after the timer expires. SVC-007 re-validates valid_until > now at the point of processing the acceptance request. This prevents stale-rate execution which would be both a commercial risk and a MiFIR compliance issue.

new_entities.name: FXSettlement
new_entities.description: Settlement record for an FX spot trade. Created by SVC-007 (Treasury Services) at PH-063 (value_date T+2) when settlement is initiated. Tracks the status of both the buy leg (nostro account credited with buy_currency) and sell leg (nostro account debited of sell_currency) through to final settlement confirmation received from SVC-010 (International Payments, CAP-003). Owned by SVC-007.

fields.name: settlement_id
fields.validation_rule: RFC 4122 UUID v4. System-generated. Immutable.

fields.name: trade_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. FK → FXTrade.trade_id (ENT-040). One-to-one relationship. Immutable.

fields.name: buy_leg_nostro
fields.validation_rule: Required. SWIFT BIC (8 or 11 characters) of the bank's nostro account in the buy_currency. e.g. USD nostro at correspondent bank. Sourced from the bank's nostro account registry for the buy_currency at time of settlement initiation.

fields.name: sell_leg_nostro
fields.validation_rule: Required. SWIFT BIC (8 or 11 characters) of the bank's nostro account in the sell_currency. Sourced from the bank's nostro account registry for the sell_currency.

fields.name: settlement_status
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: pending | initiated | sanctions_hold | failed | settled. Transitions: pending → initiated (EVT-087 published); initiated → settled (EVT-088 received from CAP-003); initiated → sanctions_hold (sanctions hit received); initiated → failed (settlement failed at nostro).

fields.name: settled_at
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. ISO 8601 UTC. Populated when settlement_status = settled. Sourced from EVT-088 payload. Immutable.

fields.name: swift_settlement_ref
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. SWIFT transaction reference from MT300 / pacs.009 settlement message. Format: 16-character SWIFT TRN. Populated when settlement_status = settled.

fields.name: created_at
fields.validation_rule: System-generated. ISO 8601 UTC. Immutable.

relationships.description: FXSettlement belongs to one FXTrade via trade_id FK.

design_decisions.decision: FXSettlement.settled_at and swift_settlement_ref are derived from EVT-088 (FXSettlementCompleted) payload received from SVC-010 (CAP-003).
design_decisions.rationale: SVC-010 (CAP-003) owns the nostro settlement execution and is the authoritative source of the settlement timestamp and SWIFT reference. SVC-007 receives confirmation via EVT-088 and populates these fields from the event payload. This maintains clean capability ownership — SVC-007 does not independently verify settlement; it trusts the event from the owning service.

design_decisions.decision: settlement_status = sanctions_hold is a terminal state requiring MLRO resolution, not automated retry.
design_decisions.rationale: An OFSI sanctions hit is a regulatory event that cannot be resolved by automated system retry. Manual MLRO (PER-058) review is mandatory. Fail-closed design: settlement_status remains sanctions_hold until an explicit MLRO authorisation event is received. This satisfies GOV-005-R02 and POCA 2002 tipping-off obligations.

referenced_existing_entities.name: BusinessCustomer
referenced_existing_entities.usage_in_journey: PH-059: SVC-007 calls SVC-005 synchronously (same-capability) to validate BusinessCustomer.status = active before creating FXTrade. Reference via FXTrade.client_id FK. SVC-007 holds no local copy of BusinessCustomer fields.

referenced_existing_entities.name: BusinessAccount
referenced_existing_entities.usage_in_journey: PH-061: SVC-007 calls SVC-005 to check sell-currency account balance before booking trade. PH-063: SVC-007 calls SVC-005 to debit sell-currency account and credit buy-currency account at settlement.
